title: Ingress sa TLS-om, zaštita metadata servisa i provjera binarnih fajlova
summary: Ingress sa TLS-om i HTTPS redirectom, blokada cloud metadata servisa i zaštita kubelet API-ja, te provjera binarnih fajlova Kubernetesa preko SHA512 i cosign potpisa.
title_en: Ingress with TLS, metadata service protection and binary verification
summary_en: Ingress with TLS and HTTPS redirect, blocking the cloud metadata service and protecting the kubelet API, plus verifying Kubernetes binaries with SHA512 and cosign signatures.
